_comment: USD per million tokens. Edit freely; the file is re-read when it changes, no restart needed. Each model needs input, output, cache_read and cache_write. A model that is absent, or has a missing or null price, shows as a dash. Keys starting with _ are ignored. A dated id such as name-20260101 also matches an entry for name.
_source: Claude API reference table cached 2026-10-06. Published: input, output, and the cache_read of claude-fable-5-1, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5. Derived from the published multipliers: cache_write = 1.25x input (5-minute TTL) and every other cache_read = 0.1x input. Check them against the current pricing page.
